name: MiMo-V2.6 Flash Free
feedback: In `scripts/critter.gd`, chain a 0.08 s impact squish to `scale = Vector2(1.18, 0.82)` with `TRANS_QUAD/EASE_OUT`, a 0.12 s pop to `Vector2(0.94, 1.08)` using `TRANS_BACK/EASE_OUT`, then a 0.20 s settle to `Vector2(1.0, 1.0)` with `TRANS_ELASTIC/EASE_OUT` anchored to the feet pivot. Drive each ear from body acceleration with a 50–70 ms delayed angular spring (stiffness 18–24, damping 7–10) adding slight overshoot and rotation clamping. Track the interaction pointer with eyes using 10–12 Hz exponential smoothing, clamping pupil travel within eye socket bounds, followed by a 0.25 s relaxed recenter when released.

name: Muse Spark 1.3 Free
feedback: Run a 3.0–3.2 s breathing loop with 2–4% chest rise, subtle belly expansion, and an 80–150 ms head follow lag. Blink at randomized 2.5–6.5 s intervals using 90 ms close / 130 ms open (70% asymmetric with 25–40 ms eyelid lead, 18% double-blinks with 120 ms gap). Crossfade mood poses over 180–350 ms with cubic ease-in-out: Happy uses an upward rebound (+10% stretch / -6% squish), Sleepy a delayed head-droop, Hungry a rhythmic tummy pat, and Curious a 200 ms head/ear perk. Enforce a minimum on-screen stroke weight of 1.5–2.0 px with round caps and `vector-effect="non-scaling-stroke"` to maintain vector outline integrity during scaling.

name: Big Pickle
feedback: In `scripts/ui/baking.gd`, animate dough with a springy 0.20–0.24 s fold: squash to `(0.92, 1.08)`, rotate about 4–6°, overshoot to `(1.06, 0.96)`, then settle on a 70–100 ms beat. Pulse broth bubbles independently every 0.8–1.2 s (scale 1.0→1.18→1.0 with an alpha fade), while egg-crema rotates continuously at 1.5–2.0 rad/s with a subtle ±0.04-radian wobble. On recipe complete, punch the treat 0.75→1.18→1.0 in 0.28 s with `TRANS_BACK`, expand a golden halo 0.2→1.6 while fading over 0.45 s, then bounce the presentation on the pedestal.

name: Step-5 Preview Free
feedback: Drive critter meadow waddle from movement speed at 0.28–0.32 s per step, alternating foot plants with a 2–3 px body bob at twice step frequency and a 2–3° side-to-side roll. Emit one footstep dust puff per foot plant, expanding over 0.18–0.25 s and drifting opposite travel direction. Offset neighboring tall grass blades by phase, swaying over 1.5–2.5 s with 4–8° amplitude, while butterflies follow looping 2.5–4.0 s Bezier curves with 8–12 px vertical flutter. Make harvesting feel crisp with a 70 ms anticipatory stretch to 1.08×, a 90 ms pluck snap to 0.92×, and a 160–220 ms springy settle with a pollen burst.

name: LongCat 2.5 Preview Free
feedback: Touch responses feel most readable with an instant, springy tap recoil that quickly settles into a slower, looping purr sway when held. For sleep, use gently timed floating Zzz bubbles, subtle chest heaves, and occasional soft ear twitches so the loop feels calm rather than mechanically repetitive. Playful idles bounce, paw, and tease with buoyant asymmetry, while Adventurous idles lean forward, scan horizons, and fidget alertly. These contrasting rhythms make the critter feel immediately reactive, quietly vulnerable at rest, and expressive across emotional states.
